text: Pinned sample_density_time differs from template/fixation similarity sampling: it excludes ALL copies of the true template index before finite sampling, retaining the remaining source-occurrence multiset. Preserve this measured contract; do not carry the other facade sample-before-first-exclusion divergence into temporal claims. cut(right=FALSE, include.lowest=TRUE) admits the final endpoint and needs an explicit point-bin endpoint type distinct from EpochPlan final short-bin policy.
